value.value: weigh and calculate percent yield; obtain an infrared spectrum
2 g anhydrous magnesium sulfate
15 mL alcohol + 20 mL glacial acetic acid + 4 mL conc. H2SO4
combine alcohol and acid, then add conc. H2SO4 with caution
boiling stones for even reflux
reflux the mixture for 1 hour
reflux (boiling mixture on a heating mantle)
cool to room temperature
55 mL cold water + 10 mL rinse; separate the lower aqueous layer
wash until the aqueous layer is basic to litmus
25 mL of 5% sodium bicarbonate, twice
25 mL water
5 mL saturated NaCl to aid layer separation (swirl, do not shake)
2 g anhydrous magnesium sulfate
collect the fraction between 134 and 143 C
fractional distillation, 134-143 C fraction
